overview: Handshaking lemma, graphic sequences, minimum/maximum degree bounds, distinct degrees.
coreConcept: Sum of degrees = 2|E|; odd-degree vertices ki count even.
hinglishExplanation: Sequence graphic hai ya nahi: sum even ho aur Erdos-Gallai / Havel-Hakimi pass ho. Simple graph me do vertices same degree hote hain (pigeonhole).
formalDefinition: Sum of degrees = 2|E|; odd-degree vertices ki count even.
importantProperties: Simple graph with n>=2 vertices me kam se kam do same degree.
Tree: E = n-1; kam se kam 2 leaves.
